equity.level_reason: Health equity is raised only as an EtR consideration (the cheaper 2-dose series is anticipated to increase health equity); no SPD groups are analyzed.

level_alternative.reason: No SPD appears at all; the equity mention is a generic EtR criterion rather than a recommendation about any social group.

equity.equity_measurement: No SPD-defined groups; equity appears only as an anticipated EtR benefit tied to lower cost.

notes: The pooled RR is read as the Work Group's own estimate from its systematic review; if it is taken as cited from GRADE tables, data_focus would be limited. GRADE certainty ratings and the booster-vs-no-booster conclusion (no numbers) are not statistical procedures. The chloroquine 'significant reduction' is cited from reference 14, not the report's own analysis.
